name: 9h nine hours Hakata station
detail: First of all, it's close to Hakata Station. I was a bit lost in the building, but anyway, it was very clean. Each locker is spacious enough to fit coats, carry cases, shoes, and bags. Bath towels, regular towels, slippers, and top and bottom sleepwear can be placed in a non-woven bag, which you can conveniently take to the shower. I was very impressed that the fixture for holding the shower head can move left and right. You can freely eat meals in the lounge, which is spacious and easy to use. The room is also spacious, with adjustable lighting, and both the bedding and comforter are clean. The comforter is just the right temperature. I also received a breakfast voucher that included a burger and a drink or miso soup at a nearby shop. Takeout is also available. The price is highly recommended overall.

name: APA Hotel Hakataeki Chikushiguchi
detail: Advantages - 1. It's really clean. There isn't a speck of dust. 2. The bedding is cozy and nice. Especially, the pillow was low and comfortable as a neck pillow. 3. It's conveniently located near Hakata Station. 4. The staff are all friendly. Disadvantages - 1. I've heard that Japanese hotels are small, and it's true. It's so small that two people can hardly pass by each other without bumping into things, aside from the bed and shelf table. 2. The bathroom is also small. You bump into things while showering. It was a bit difficult for someone over 180cm.

name: APA Hotel Hakata Gion Ekimae
detail: I felt that the price at the APA Hotel was a bit high for my first stay, but it is in an easy-to-find location near Hakata Station. The room isn't very spacious, but I really liked the comfort of the bed and pillow, the thorough cleanliness, and the quietness✨️. The reception service was also excellent. I appreciated the friendly response. This is my favorite business hotel I've stayed at so far. Both my daughter and I were able to rest our tired bodies well, and we were very satisfied. If given the opportunity, I would definitely like to stay here again. It would be even better if the price could be a little lower.

name: UNPLAN Fukuoka
detail: After the LIVE at PayPay Dome Recommended points The location is unbeatable and the luggage storage is excellent. A clean sheet with a sleep environment where you won’t be bothered by sounds or lights next door. Delicious coffee served at breakfast ☀️🍴 Considerations There’s a huge crowd in the shower room. Having toilet sandals or slippers makes using the restroom easier. It’s expensive, but that’s expected after the LIVE. I would like to use it again 😊

name: The Millennials Fukuoka
detail: The bar on the first floor had a DJ and felt like a hotel abroad! There was a service time where you could drink alcohol and non-alcoholic beverages for free, and the atmosphere was great! The lounge was also beautiful, and unlimited water and coffee were available! The water flow in the shower was also not a problem! The bed was electric and could turn into a sofa, and the space was surprisingly spacious, not what you would expect from a capsule hotel!

name: Hakata Green Hotel Annex
detail: It's a spacious room that's not bad for solo use, even enough to unfold a suitcase. The hygiene was clean, and there were no bad smells. The staff are all friendly, and although check-in/check-out is done via a kiosk, as soon as you head towards the kiosk, a staff member comes running out to assist you. It's great that there's a Family Mart directly connected on the first floor of the hotel. It's a bit small, but there's a larger Family Mart just across the alley. Most importantly, it's very close to Hakata Station; you can arrive in just a minute without the risk of getting lost, making it safe and highly recommended for solo travelers.

name: WeBase HAKATA Hostel
detail: I used a 4-person room with bunk beds. The room was very clean. The shower room and powder room were also hygienic. Breakfast included bread, jam, yogurt, cereal, milk, coffee, and juice. It takes about a 20-minute walk to Marine Messe. I'm very satisfied with the price and everything. One point: I requested earplugs and room wear at the front desk to be left in my room, but they weren't there. However, I was able to sleep soundly. I will stay here again during the next live event.

name: TOWER HOTEL
detail: It’s a new hotel, so it has great cost performance, and it’s incredibly spacious and nice! The bathroom is very spacious, and the bedroom is also very large. I’m very satisfied!! The staff are very friendly, and since I had an early morning flight, I checked out at dawn and requested a taxi; they called one for me and checked on me until I left. It’s excellent for unpacking luggage as well. The downside is that the room lock is still a key, and it makes a bit of noise when moving around? It’s a bit far from Tianjin and Hakata, but public transportation is available. It’s a perfect accommodation.

name: Hakata Green Hotel Building No.1
detail: We stayed for two people, and as I expected from other reviews, the room was really small when we first entered! It was somewhat cramped for two people to move around at the same time. Other than that, the cleanliness, the staff's guidance, the amenities, and the condition of the bed were all excellent. Among accommodations near Hakata Station, I think it offers good value for money. Breakfast can be had on the second floor of the annex building (Japanese style) or on the first floor of the main building (Western style), and the Western style is a bit better, haha. However, if I visit again, I would like to skip breakfast. The quality is good, but since Fukuoka is a city known for its food, it seems better to go to another restaurant instead. If I return to Fukuoka, I plan to visit Green Hotel again!

name: Hotel Route Inn Hakata Ekimae - Hakataguchi
detail: I think the location is really top-notch without a doubt. Of course, there are many other hotels in front of Hakata Station, but we mainly roamed around the Hakata Bus Terminal and Kitte. When you go up from the first floor to the second floor, there's the Route Inn Hakata Hotel right after crossing the overpass, and coming down and straight into the entrance to drop off our shopping bags, it was very nice to go back over the pedestrian bridge and explore Hakata Station. I didn't expect breakfast, but it was offered for free to all guests. Although there weren't an overwhelming number of options, I had planned to eat lightly but ended up overeating...^^ The curry was so delicious. I had a hearty meal with bread, drinks, salad, warm soup, and side dishes, which made my morning schedule comfortable. I heard there is a big bath, but I regretted not being able to visit it due to our schedule, and there was a space to keep our luggage freely, so we kept shopping and storing our bags repeatedly. The staff were friendly, and there were two who spoke Korean well. Amenities could be picked up from the lobby. The room was small, but we chose this accommodation with the plan to just sleep, so the size of the room was... well, haha... It was very hot on the day I visited, but the air conditioning worked well, and the bedding was clean, so I rested well. Slippers and indoor clothes were prepared, so I could wear the indoor clothes to the big bath and for breakfast. Initially, I had concerns because there weren't many reviews, but after staying there, I truly think it was an amazing place, especially in terms of location. I highly recommend it!
